resiliency_board.events_line: Data days: FRED's own release dates (jobs report, CPI, Core PCE, GDP, retail sales, JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims, PPI) and the Fed's FOMC calendar. ISM and Fed-speaker remarks have no dated history here and are not counted.

lines: Held = the close on a data day no more than 0.5% under the prior session's close (prior close to that day's close — an intraday dip that recovers counts as held). Down-only, absolute, not against SPY: your call.
🛡️ box = a close on every T1 (or T2) day of the last 365 days and held on at least 75% of them. A name missing a close is not rated and a ticked box hides it.
T1 = the jobs report, CPI, Core PCE and the FOMC decision; T2 = retail sales, JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims, GDP and PPI — a day with any T1 print counts as T1 only.
'SPY fell' = SPY's own close-to-close on that day below zero.
📈 = the app's accumulation day on the last session: up close, close in the upper half of the range, volume above its 50-session average.

📅 Today's move = the price against the prior session's close: live in market hours, the regular-session close after it, and before the open, overnight and on weekends the last session's close against the one before it, labelled with its date (closed bars, checked against the snapshot). On a T1/T2 day the card also says T1/T2, and its pre-market print is read live. The same 0.5% line colours it.

Default order: today's move, biggest gain first, once the session has a print (market hours and after the close); before that, 🛡️ T1 hold rate. A name with no print sorts last; ties go to the T1 hold rate. The 📅 line counts every name read, before the boxes and the liquidity floor.

🚀 Sales + EPS growth = the latest reported quarter against the same quarter a year earlier. Order: names ranked on BOTH legs first, then one leg (an EPS leg before a sales leg), then none; within a block each leg's percentile is averaged — the breakouts board's blend. Never ranked: a year-ago EPS under $0.10 or a year-ago loss, a year-ago revenue under $1M or at or under zero, quarters not a year apart on file, a latest filing 4 or more quarters past due, an ETF/fund, and a stored figure that is missing or disagrees with its own quarterly series (shown with *). UNMEASURED — an order, not a forecast.

🌅 box is OFF: volume check off until the two volume sources are reconciled (pre-market volume not compared — the snapshot's pre-market shares read higher than the 1-minute bars the usual volume is built from; your call) — it passes none; the pre-market move still shows 04:00–09:30 ET.
